policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: V launches W-6 for autonomous hypersonic reentry
items.summary: V launched W-6 with SpaceX’s Transporter-16, advancing autonomous navigation and next-gen thermal protection. Mission includes AFRL-funded flight testing and in-flight collection of thermal/material performance data.

items.headline: O publishes Frontier Governance Framework
items.summary: O published a governance framework describing how its safety/security practices align with emerging legal obligations (e.g., CA Transparency in Frontier AI Act, EU AI Act Code of Practice).

items.headline: O raises $122B at $852B post-money valuation
items.summary: O closed a $122B funding round at a $852B post-money valuation, also citing scaling of revenue and expanding enterprise mix; revolver expanded to ~$4.7B (undrawn).

items.headline: G raises $650M to scale inference cloud
items.summary: G announced $650M growth capital to expand its AI inference cloud, including scaling toward ~200 MW by end-2027; cites current operation of 13 data centers and token processing scale.
